freeze.checkpoint: Final2048 only; no early stopping or threshold tuning.
freeze.policy: Declared initialization seed, fixed data/schedule/Adam.001/microbatch1x4, no best-seed selection.
freeze.local_features: Absolute central H/V slopes and H/V second differences, four values per physical plane; two equivariant convolutions then head.
freeze.evaluation: 80consulted cases; full/bias/image-mean/core-mean/disabled-local frozen ablations; no independent confirmation here.
freeze.objective_policy: Per-example RGB MSE divided by max(bilinear RGB MSE,1e-6 physical units); training truth only, detached denominator, same 48px crop. No gate change.

limits: Procedural reconstruction without noise, controls already consulted, no real-photo benefit claimed.
Local branch adds2068parameters; useful diagnostic cannot isolate path length, descriptors and added capacity.
Disabled branch is an ablation of jointly trained weights, not an independently optimized filter.
No training on noise if20/80historical gates remain failed.
